cases.title: Registered Nurse - Aged Care
cases.body:
Our residential care service is recruiting a registered nurse to coordinate the clinical care of older residents. On each shift you will review care plans, administer prescribed medicines, assess changes in residents' condition and speak with families about ongoing care. A clinical lead is available for escalation, while the nurse manages routine decisions for an allocated group of residents. This role does not include managing the whole facility.

Applicants must have at least 2 years of nursing experience in residential aged care.
Current New Zealand nursing registration and a valid practising certificate are essential.
You must be competent in safe medication administration and clinical documentation.
Knowledge of dementia care is preferred.

We offer visa sponsorship for the successful applicant.
Applicants do not need to already hold New Zealand work rights when they apply.
Any required permission must be in place before employment begins. The roster includes morning and evening shifts, and handovers are scheduled within paid time. We provide a structured orientation to the care records system and access to continuing professional development.

skills.text: Applicants must have at least 2 years of nursing experience in residential aged care.
Current New Zealand nursing registration and a valid practising certificate are essential.
You must be competent in safe medication administration and clinical documentation.
Knowledge of dementia care is preferred.

experience.text: Applicants must have at least 2 years of nursing experience in residential aged care.

cases.title: Personal Care Assistant
cases.body:
A personal care assistant is needed on an inpatient rehabilitation unit. You will help patients wash, dress and move between their beds and chairs, following the care plan set by the nursing team. You will report discomfort or changes in mobility to the nurse on duty and keep routine care notes.

A minimum of 6 months of experience providing personal care in a health facility is required.
Safe manual handling skills are essential.
A current first aid certificate is preferred.

Clinical diagnosis and medicine prescribing are outside this position. Shifts are agreed through a regular roster, and paid orientation covers the unit's transfer equipment and reporting procedures.

skills.text: A minimum of 6 months of experience providing personal care in a health facility is required.
Safe manual handling skills are essential.
A current first aid certificate is preferred.

experience.text: A minimum of 6 months of experience providing personal care in a health facility is required.

cases.title: Aged or Disabled Carer - Home Visits
cases.body:
Support older people and disabled adults in their own homes as an aged or disabled carer. Visits involve help with meals, dressing, household tasks and accompanied trips to community appointments. A coordinator provides each client's support plan and remains available during visits.

A full New Zealand driver licence is required for travel between clients.
Patient and respectful communication skills are essential.
No previous care work experience is required because supervised training is provided.

Applicants must already have the right to work in New Zealand.
We cannot offer visa sponsorship for this position.
Travel between scheduled visits is paid.

skills.text: A full New Zealand driver licence is required for travel between clients.
Patient and respectful communication skills are essential.

cases.title: Primary School Teacher
cases.body:
We are appointing a primary school teacher for a mixed-ability class. The teacher plans and delivers literacy, mathematics and inquiry lessons, checks pupil progress and adapts activities for children who need additional support. You will maintain learning records and meet families to discuss progress. Shared planning time with other teachers is part of the timetable, and specialist support is available for complex learning needs.

Applicants must have between 1 and 3 years of primary classroom teaching experience.
Current New Zealand teacher registration and a practising certificate are required.
Knowledge of the New Zealand primary curriculum is essential.
Familiarity with digital assessment tools is desirable.

Applications are restricted to New Zealand citizens or permanent residents.
Applicants must already hold the legal right to work in New Zealand.

The position includes classroom teaching, playground supervision and collaborative planning. It does not carry a senior leadership allowance or responsibility for appraising other teachers. Classroom resources and scheduled professional learning are provided.

skills.text: Applicants must have between 1 and 3 years of primary classroom teaching experience.
Current New Zealand teacher registration and a practising certificate are required.
Knowledge of the New Zealand primary curriculum is essential.
Familiarity with digital assessment tools is desirable.

cases.title: Early Childhood Teacher
cases.body:
An early childhood teacher will join our teaching team for children below school age. You will design play-based learning activities, document children's interests and discuss learning with families. A mentor supports new teachers with planning and reflective practice.

Current New Zealand teacher registration, including provisional registration, is required.
The ability to plan safe play-based learning is essential.
Knowledge of te reo Maori is an advantage.
New graduates are welcome to apply.

We may provide visa sponsorship for this teaching position.
Applicants do not need to hold existing New Zealand work rights at the application stage.
We arrange planning time away from the children each week.

skills.text: Current New Zealand teacher registration, including provisional registration, is required.
The ability to plan safe play-based learning is essential.
Knowledge of te reo Maori is an advantage.

cases.title: Learning Facilitator
cases.body:
This classroom position teaches physics to secondary school pupils. You will prepare secondary school lessons, demonstrate experiments, mark assessments and report progress to families. The timetable includes both junior science and senior physics classes; it is not an adult training or early childhood role.

A physics degree or an equivalent recognised teaching subject qualification is required.
Current New Zealand teacher registration is essential.
Knowledge of school laboratory safety is preferred.

The science department shares laboratory resources and moderation sessions. A subject leader coordinates the programme, while each teacher manages the day-to-day learning and assessment of their own classes.

skills.text: A physics degree or an equivalent recognised teaching subject qualification is required.
Current New Zealand teacher registration is essential.
Knowledge of school laboratory safety is preferred.

cases.title: Carpenter - Residential Framing
cases.body:
Join a small site crew building timber-framed houses. The carpenter sets out framing from drawings, cuts and fixes structural timber, installs doors and checks dimensions before the next trade starts. Site work is coordinated by a foreperson, but each carpenter checks the quality of their own completed work.

At least 4 years of carpentry experience is required.
A carpentry trade certificate is essential.
You must be able to read building drawings and use power tools safely.
A current first aid certificate is desirable.

We supply scaffolding and shared lifting equipment. This position involves hands-on carpentry rather than project estimating or managing subcontractor budgets.

skills.text: At least 4 years of carpentry experience is required.
A carpentry trade certificate is essential.
You must be able to read building drawings and use power tools safely.
A current first aid certificate is desirable.

experience.text: At least 4 years of carpentry experience is required.

cases.title: Electrician - General Installation
cases.body:
The electrician installs wiring and switchboards in commercial fit-outs, tests completed circuits and diagnoses faults reported during handover. You will record test results and coordinate access with the site supervisor. The work is building electrical installation, not automotive electronics.

Between 3 and 5 years of electrical installation experience is required.
Current EWRB registration and a valid electrical practising licence are essential.
A full driver licence is preferred.

cases.title: Plumber - Maintenance
cases.body:
Our maintenance plumber diagnoses leaking fixtures, replaces water pipework and tests repaired plumbing in occupied buildings. You will explain the repair to the customer and complete a service record before leaving each property. Specialist drainage work is allocated to a separate team.

Current New Zealand plumber registration and a practising licence are essential.
A backflow testing certificate is preferred.
You must be able to interpret plumbing plans and locate water isolation points safely.

Applicants must already have the legal right to work in New Zealand.
A vehicle and scheduled technical training are included in the role.

skills.text: Current New Zealand plumber registration and a practising licence are essential.
A backflow testing certificate is preferred.
You must be able to interpret plumbing plans and locate water isolation points safely.

cases.title: Truck Driver - Class 5 Freight
cases.body:
Drive articulated heavy trucks between distribution depots and customer unloading points. The truck driver completes vehicle checks, secures general freight and records driving time in a logbook. Dispatch sets the route, while the driver checks that each load is safe before departure.

At least 18 months of heavy truck driving experience is required.
A current New Zealand Class 5 driver licence is essential.
A dangerous goods endorsement is preferred.

Applicants must already hold New Zealand work rights.
One application condition says that only New Zealand citizens or residents may apply.
Another condition says that temporary work visa holders may also apply.
Both conditions remain in this vacancy notice.

skills.text: At least 18 months of heavy truck driving experience is required.
A current New Zealand Class 5 driver licence is essential.
A dangerous goods endorsement is preferred.

experience.text: At least 18 months of heavy truck driving experience is required.

cases.title: Forklift Driver
cases.body:
Operate a forklift to unload pallets, place stock in warehouse racking and move picked orders to the loading area. The forklift driver checks the machine at the start of each shift and follows pedestrian separation rules. A team lead allocates tasks and provides induction on the warehouse layout.

A current forklift operator certificate is required.
A current F endorsement is essential for the yard's road access area.
Familiarity with barcode scanners is desirable.
No previous warehouse work experience is required.

The roster covers daytime shifts. Manual packing is an occasional supporting task rather than the main purpose of this position.

skills.text: A current forklift operator certificate is required.
A current F endorsement is essential for the yard's road access area.
Familiarity with barcode scanners is desirable.

cases.title: Despatching and Receiving Clerk
cases.body:
The despatching and receiving clerk checks incoming goods against delivery notes, records stock movements and prepares outbound shipping documents. You will investigate quantity differences and contact transport providers about collection times. Warehouse operators handle forklift movements.

Accurate stock-counting and record-keeping skills are essential.
Knowledge of spreadsheet formulas is preferred.
A forklift licence is not required for this clerical position.

We do not provide visa sponsorship for this role.
Training covers the stock system and our document retention process. The role is based at the dispatch desk with regular checks on the warehouse floor.

skills.text: Accurate stock-counting and record-keeping skills are essential.
Knowledge of spreadsheet formulas is preferred.

cases.title: Chef - Restaurant Kitchen
cases.body:
Our restaurant needs a chef to plan seasonal dishes and lead service in an allocated kitchen section. You will prepare sauces and main courses, set the preparation list, check food quality and help coordinate the timing of orders. The head chef approves menu changes and manages the wider kitchen budget. During quieter services you will test recipes and update the preparation instructions used by the team.

Applicants must have at least 3 years of professional experience.
A current food hygiene certificate is required.
Knowledge of allergen controls and safe food storage is essential.
Pastry preparation skills are preferred.

We cannot provide visa sponsorship for this vacancy.

The restaurant supplies kitchen equipment and uniforms. Service schedules are published ahead of time, and staff meals are available during shifts. The role involves cooking and supervising preparation, rather than only reheating ready-made products or serving customers at tables. Kitchen cleaning duties are shared at the end of service.

skills.text: A current food hygiene certificate is required.
Knowledge of allergen controls and safe food storage is essential.
Pastry preparation skills are preferred.

experience.text: Applicants must have at least 3 years of professional experience.

cases.title: Waiter - Table Service
cases.body:
Welcome guests, take orders at the table, carry meals and clear settings in a seated dining room. The waiter checks dietary requests with the kitchen and presents bills at the end of the meal. A duty manager coordinates the floor during busy service.

Between 6 and 12 months of table-service experience is required.
Clear spoken communication and safe tray-handling skills are essential.
Familiarity with a restaurant point-of-sale system is preferred.

We may offer visa sponsorship for this position.
The eligibility section says applicants must already hold New Zealand work rights.
The same section also says applicants do not need to already hold New Zealand work rights.
Both clauses are included in the notice.

Familiarity with a restaurant point-of-sale system is preferred.

cases.title: Cook - Community Dining
cases.body:
The cook prepares meals from an established menu for a community dining service. Work includes weighing ingredients, cooking vegetables and proteins, checking temperatures and portioning meals for service. A kitchen supervisor plans menus and orders stock, so this position focuses on preparing the agreed dishes.

Knowledge of food hygiene and allergen separation is required.
Confident knife-handling skills are desirable.
A formal cookery qualification is not required because supervised kitchen training is provided.

Equipment and recipes are supplied. The kitchen serves a regular meal schedule rather than an open-ended restaurant service, and cleaning is shared among the team.

skills.text: Knowledge of food hygiene and allergen separation is required.
Confident knife-handling skills are desirable.

cases.title: Accountant - Financial Reporting
cases.body:
The accountant prepares monthly financial statements, reconciles balance-sheet accounts and reviews adjustments before the reporting pack is issued. You will help prepare tax working papers and respond to audit queries. Payroll processing and purchase invoice entry are handled by separate staff.

At least 2 years of financial accounting experience is required.
A recognised accounting degree or equivalent professional qualification is required.
Proficiency in spreadsheet analysis is essential.
Chartered accountant membership is preferred.

Applicants must already hold New Zealand work rights.
We are unable to offer visa sponsorship.
The finance manager reviews final reports and supports development in complex reporting areas.

skills.text: At least 2 years of financial accounting experience is required.
A recognised accounting degree or equivalent professional qualification is required.
Proficiency in spreadsheet analysis is essential.
Chartered accountant membership is preferred.

cases.title: Bookkeeper
cases.body:
Maintain day-to-day financial records for a small internal accounts team. The bookkeeper enters invoices, reconciles bank transactions, keeps the general ledger current and prepares routine GST information for review. An external accountant handles annual financial statements and complex tax advice.

Proficiency in bookkeeping software is required.
Knowledge of GST transaction coding is essential.
Payroll processing knowledge is preferred.
No university degree is required for this position.

You will follow established approval limits and raise unusual transactions with the accounts supervisor. We provide an induction to the chart of accounts and document storage process.

skills.text: Proficiency in bookkeeping software is required.
Knowledge of GST transaction coding is essential.
Payroll processing knowledge is preferred.

cases.title: Office Partner
cases.body:
Carry out general clerical duties for an office team: file documents, enter records, sort incoming mail and arrange meeting rooms. You will check routine forms for missing information and direct unusual requests to the office coordinator. This position does not involve preparing financial statements, selling products or managing staff.

Accurate data-entry skills are essential.
Familiarity with word-processing software is required.
Knowledge of electronic filing conventions is desirable.
A business degree is not required.

Procedures and templates are supplied. New starters receive guidance on the filing system and routine correspondence before handling the daily task list independently.

skills.text: Accurate data-entry skills are essential.
Familiarity with word-processing software is required.
Knowledge of electronic filing conventions is desirable.

cases.title: Call or Contact Centre Operator
cases.body:
Answer incoming customer calls in a contact centre, check order information and record the outcome of each enquiry. The operator explains standard return procedures, arranges follow-up when an order is delayed and refers complaints outside agreed limits to a team leader. The work is customer service rather than troubleshooting computer systems or writing software.

At least 6 months of experience handling customer enquiries in a contact centre is required.
Clear telephone communication and accurate typing skills are essential.
Familiarity with customer account systems is preferred.

cases.title: Sales Assistant - General Retail
cases.body:
Help customers choose everyday household products in a retail shop. The sales assistant explains product features, operates the checkout, refills shelves and keeps the display area tidy. A store supervisor handles purchasing and staffing decisions.

One year of retail sales experience is preferred.
The ability to operate a cash register accurately is required.
Knowledge of household product categories is desirable.
No specialist sales qualification is required.

Applications are restricted to New Zealand citizens or residents.
The roster includes some weekend shifts. Product training and till induction are provided before independent shifts.

skills.text: One year of retail sales experience is preferred.
The ability to operate a cash register accurately is required.

cases.title: Customer Service Manager
cases.body:
Lead a customer service department handling telephone and email enquiries. The manager sets service procedures, coaches team leaders, reviews complaint trends and adjusts staffing plans to meet demand. Routine calls are answered by the operator team, with complex escalations referred to this position.

Staff coaching and complaint-resolution skills are essential.
Knowledge of service-quality reporting is required.
Familiarity with workforce planning software is preferred.

Applicants must already hold the legal right to work in New Zealand.

cases.title: Developer Programmer - Business Applications
cases.body:
Build and maintain internal business applications as a developer programmer. You will translate agreed requirements into working features, implement data validation, write automated tests and investigate defects found by users. A technical lead reviews design decisions, while each developer owns the implementation and testing of assigned work. Most changes are delivered in small increments so that staff can give feedback before a feature is expanded.

At least 2 years of software development experience is required.
Six months of React development experience is preferred.
Proficiency in TypeScript is essential.
Knowledge of SQL query writing is desirable.
A computing degree or an equivalent professional software qualification is required.

We offer visa sponsorship for this vacancy.

The role uses a code review process and scheduled releases. It does not involve operating a help desk or managing corporate networks. Documentation time is included in the delivery schedule, and the team shares responsibility for reviewing tests before changes reach users.

cases.title: Network Administrator
cases.body:
Administer the organisation's routers, switches and network access controls. The network administrator investigates connectivity faults, checks monitoring alerts, updates network diagrams and carries out approved configuration changes. Major architecture changes are reviewed by a senior infrastructure lead.

Knowledge of BGP and OSPF routing is essential.
The ability to diagnose network connectivity faults is required.
A current Cisco networking certification is preferred.

No software programming qualification is required.
Maintenance work is planned within an agreed change window, and escalation support is available for unfamiliar faults. The position focuses on data networks rather than building websites.

skills.text: Knowledge of BGP and OSPF routing is essential.
The ability to diagnose network connectivity faults is required.
A current Cisco networking certification is preferred.

cases.title: ICT Customer Support Officer
cases.body:
Provide first-line ICT help desk support to staff using office computers. You will record support requests, guide users through basic troubleshooting, set up approved peripherals and escalate unresolved incidents to a technician. A mentor checks new starters' work and demonstrates the support procedures before they handle the queue independently.

Basic desktop troubleshooting skills are required.
Clear and patient communication with non-technical users is essential.
Familiarity with ticket-tracking software is preferred.
No previous paid IT work experience is required.

The role includes supervised induction and written troubleshooting guides. It does not carry responsibility for changing network architecture or developing applications.

skills.text: Basic desktop troubleshooting skills are required.
Clear and patient communication with non-technical users is essential.
Familiarity with ticket-tracking software is preferred.
